text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add LTX-Video’s 1080p motion model to EXCAVA’s pipeline. It cuts motion blur better than Runway Gen-4’s upscaler, which only sharpens static frames. The trade-off is higher compute cost per clip, but the quality gain outweighs it for motion-heavy footage.

name: Torque
text: LTX-Video’s motion model won’t fix EXCAVA’s 1080p ceiling—it just masks blur with heavier compute. The real risk is trading speed for marginal gains while ignoring the 4K pipeline bottleneck. Test a 1080p clip through both pipelines; if LTX-Video’s output isn’t 20% sharper in motion-heavy scenes, drop it—focus instead on a tool that actually scales resolution, like a hybrid upscaler paired with a lighter motion model.
